English: Your next chapter starts with one document.
Chinese: 从一份文档开始您的新篇章。

English: Your documents are private to you.
Chinese: 您的文档仅属于您自己。

English: We store your scans and their recognized text to run Arks Scanner, use Google services for sign-in and text recognition, and never sell your data. You can download or delete your data at any time.
Chinese: 我们会保存您的扫描件及其识别出的文字以运行 Arks Scanner，使用 Google 服务进行登录和文字识别，并且绝不出售您的数据。您可以随时下载或删除您的数据。

English: Your documents are private to you. You can take a copy of your data or delete your account at any time.
Chinese: 您的文档仅属于您自己。您可以随时获取数据副本或删除您的账户。

English: A file with your account details, documents and their recognized text, plan usage and activity.
Chinese: 一个包含您的账户信息、文档及其识别文字、套餐用量和活动记录的文件。

English: Your data file has been downloaded.
We could not prepare your data. Please try again.
Chinese: 无法准备您的数据，请重试。

English: This removes your documents and your sign-in. It cannot be undone from the app.
Chinese: 这将删除您的文档和登录账户，且无法在应用中撤销。

English: You are the only admin. Add another admin before deleting your account.
Chinese: 您是唯一的管理员。请先添加另一位管理员再删除账户。

English: Your account could not be deleted. Please try again.
Chinese: 无法删除您的账户，请重试。

English: PDF, JPEG, PNG, or HEIC · Maximum 25 MB · Private by default
Chinese: PDF、JPEG、PNG 或 HEIC · 最大 25 MB · 默认私密

English: Uploading starts as soon as you choose files, and the file name is used as the title. Type a name before choosing files, or rename it later from My documents.
Chinese: 选择文件后会立即开始上传，并以文件名作为标题。请在选择文件前输入名称，或稍后在“我的文档”中重命名。

English: Choose a PDF, JPEG, PNG, or HEIC file.
Chinese: 请选择 PDF、JPEG、PNG 或 HEIC 文件。

English: Choose a file that is not empty.
Choose a file smaller than 25 MB.
Chinese: 请选择小于 25 MB 的文件。

English: The secure upload link expired. Please try again.
Chinese: 安全上传链接已过期，请重试。

English: The file could not be uploaded. Please try again.
We could not start the scan. Please try again.
A little less paperwork. A little more peace of mind.
Chinese: 少一点纸上作业，多一份安心。

English: Please try again in a moment.
A document will be deleted within a day. Download it now, or upgrade to Pro to keep your documents.
Chinese: 有文档将在一天内被删除。请立即下载，或升级到专业版以保留您的文档。

English: Delete “{title}”? This cannot be undone from the app.
Chinese: 删除“{title}”？此操作无法在应用中撤销。

English: Deleted documents stay here for 30 days, then they are removed for good.
Chinese: 已删除的文档会在此保留 30 天，之后将被永久删除。

English: Nothing deleted in the last 30 days.
Chinese: 过去 30 天内没有删除任何文档。
删除于 {deleted} · {purge} 后永久删除

English: We could not restore this document. Please try again.
Chinese: 无法恢复此文档，请重试。

English: Restoring this would go over your plan's document limit. Delete another document or upgrade first.
Chinese: 恢复此文档将超出您套餐的文档数量上限。请先删除其他文档或升级套餐。

English: We could not load recently deleted documents.
Chinese: 无法加载最近删除的文档。

English: That document could not be deleted. Please try again.
Chinese: 无法删除该文档，请重试。

English: That document could not be renamed. Please try again.
Chinese: 无法重命名该文档，请重试。

English: A title can have at most 200 characters.
Add a mark or signature directly. To replace scanned words, recognize text first.
Chinese: 可直接添加标记或签名。要替换扫描的文字，请先识别文字。
重新加载已保存的标记
重新加载已保存的签名

English: Drag to move · corner handles resize · arrow keys move · Shift + arrows resize
Chinese: 拖动移动 · 拖动角点调整大小 · 方向键移动 · Shift + 方向键调整大小
正在检查文字识别状态…

English: To replace scanned words, select Recognize text. Tick / Cross and Add signature work without it. Recognition may use the OCR service.
Chinese: 要替换扫描的文字，请选择“识别文字”。勾 / 叉和添加签名无需此步骤。识别可能会使用 OCR 服务。

English: Try again before selecting words on this page.
Chinese: 请在选择此页文字之前重试。

English: Please wait. This page will become selectable when recognition finishes.
Chinese: 请稍候。识别完成后即可选择此页的文字。

English: Drag across words on the large image, then choose Replace or Delete. Use the zoom controls for smaller print.
Chinese: 在大图上拖动选择文字，然后选择替换或删除。小字请使用缩放控件。

English: Drag the page to move around. Hold Space and drag to pan from selectable text.
Chinese: 拖动页面可移动视图。按住空格键并拖动可从可选文字处平移。

English: Full page preview for selecting text
Chinese: 用于选择文字的整页预览

English: Could not open this page for text editing. Try again.
Chinese: 无法打开此页进行文字编辑。请重试。

English: Text recognition could not start. Try again.
Chinese: 无法开始文字识别。请重试。
放弃未保存的页面更改？
放弃未应用的文字更改？

English: Drag to place your signature, then Save.
Chinese: 拖动以放置您的签名，然后保存。

English: Could not open this signature. Choose another image.
Chinese: 无法打开此签名。请选择另一张图片。
放弃未保存的签名位置？

English: Drag to move; use the corner handles to resize. Save when ready.
Chinese: 拖动移动；用角点调整大小。准备好后保存。

English: Signature saved. Export a new PDF to include it.
Chinese: 签名已保存。请导出新的 PDF 以包含它。

English: This signature changed elsewhere. Your draft is still here. Reload saved signatures, then review and Save again.
Chinese: 此签名已在别处更改。您的草稿仍在。请重新加载已保存的签名，然后检查并再次保存。

English: Signature could not be saved. Your draft is still here. Try Save again.
Chinese: 无法保存签名。您的草稿仍在。请再次尝试保存。

English: Delete this signature from this page?
Signature deleted. Your original scan is unchanged.
Chinese: 签名已删除。您的原始扫描件未更改。

English: Could not delete the signature. Reload saved signatures and try again.
Chinese: 无法删除签名。请重新加载已保存的签名后重试。

English: This saved signature was deleted elsewhere. Cancel this placement to continue.
Chinese: 此已保存的签名已在别处删除。请取消此放置以继续。

English: Could not load saved signatures. Try Reload saved signatures.
Chinese: 无法加载已保存的签名。请尝试重新加载已保存的签名。

English: Drag to position your mark, adjust color or size, then Save.
Chinese: 拖动以定位您的标记，调整颜色或大小，然后保存。

English: This mark cannot fit at that position.
Chinese: 此标记无法放入该位置。
放弃未保存的标记更改？

English: Drag to move, use the corner handles to resize, then Save.
Chinese: 拖动移动，用角点调整大小，然后保存。

English: Duplicate ready. Drag it to another position, then Save. The original stays in place.
Chinese: 副本已就绪。将其拖到其他位置，然后保存。原标记保持不变。

English: The mark is too large for this page.
Chinese: 此标记对该页来说太大。

English: This mark was removed elsewhere. Cancel this draft, then place a new mark.
Chinese: 此标记已在别处移除。请取消此草稿，然后放置新标记。

English: Reload saved marks before trying Save again. Your draft is safe.
Chinese: 再次保存前请重新加载已保存的标记。您的草稿是安全的。

English: This mark changed elsewhere. Save your draft over its current version?
Chinese: 此标记已在别处更改。要用您的草稿覆盖当前版本吗？

English: This mark changed elsewhere. Review your draft; Save will ask before replacing the current version.
Chinese: 此标记已在别处更改。请检查您的草稿；保存时会先询问再替换当前版本。

English: Mark saved. Export a new PDF to include it.
Chinese: 标记已保存。请导出新的 PDF 以包含它。

English: This mark changed elsewhere. Your draft is safe. Reload saved marks and review it.
Chinese: 此标记已在别处更改。您的草稿是安全的。请重新加载已保存的标记并检查。

English: Mark could not be saved. Your draft is still here. Try Save again.
Chinese: 无法保存标记。您的草稿仍在。请再次尝试保存。

English: Mark removed. Your original scan is unchanged.
Chinese: 标记已移除。您的原始扫描件未更改。

English: Could not remove the mark. Reload saved marks and try again.
Chinese: 无法移除标记。请重新加载已保存的标记后重试。

English: Could not load saved marks. Try Reload saved marks.
Chinese: 无法加载已保存的标记。请尝试重新加载已保存的标记。

English: This page changed elsewhere. Saved marks were reloaded; old Undo history was cleared.
Chinese: 此页已在别处更改。已重新加载已保存的标记；旧的撤销记录已清除。

English: Could not change this mark. Your Undo history is unchanged. Try again.
Chinese: 无法更改此标记。您的撤销记录未更改。请重试。

English: Could not check text recognition. Try again.
Chinese: 无法检查文字识别。请重试。

English: Exact rendered result — review before saving
Chinese: 精确渲染结果 — 保存前请检查

English: Transparent text guide — drag or resize it on the page
Chinese: 透明文字参考框 — 在页面上拖动或调整大小

English: Transparent placement guide — old ink remains visible until you preview the exact result
Chinese: 透明位置参考框 — 在预览精确结果之前，旧字迹仍然可见

English: Drag the page to move around. Drag the text box to reposition it; hold Space and drag to move the page from the box.
Chinese: 拖动页面可移动视图。拖动文本框可重新定位；按住空格键并拖动可从文本框处移动页面。

English: No installed font can write these characters yet. Remove them or contact support.
Chinese: 目前没有已安装的字体可以书写这些字符。请删除它们或联系支持。

English: This text may need more space. Apply will check the exact fit before changing your page.
Chinese: 此文字可能需要更多空间。应用前会先检查确切是否适合，再更改您的页面。
正在准备样式和几何信息…

English: Switched to {font} so these characters can be written.
Chinese: 已切换到 {font}，以便书写这些字符。

English: Font catalogue unavailable. Recommended fonts remain available.
Chinese: 字体目录不可用。推荐字体仍可使用。

English: Enter text, drag the transparent box, then preview the exact result.
Chinese: 输入文字，拖动透明框，然后预览精确结果。

English: Sign in to add text on this page.
Chinese: 请登录以在此页添加文字。

English: Could not start adding text. Please try again.
Chinese: 无法开始添加文字。请重试。

English: No supported font is available for this selection.
Chinese: 没有适用于此选择的受支持字体。

English: Edit the text, then select Preview exact result to check it.
Chinese: 编辑文字，然后选择“预览精确结果”进行检查。

English: Low confidence font match. Review the alternatives.
Chinese: 字体匹配置信度较低。请查看备选项。

English: Text editing is disabled on this server. An administrator must enable it before edits can be applied.
Chinese: 此服务器已禁用文字编辑。管理员必须启用后才能应用编辑。

English: Sign in to edit text on this page.
Chinese: 请登录以编辑此页的文字。

English: This page changed. Close the editor and select the words again.
Chinese: 此页已更改。请关闭编辑器并重新选择文字。

English: This text selection cannot be edited. Select printed words and try again.
Chinese: 无法编辑此文字选择。请选择印刷文字后重试。

English: Could not load the text editor. Please try again.
Chinese: 无法加载文字编辑器。请重试。

English: Font preview unavailable; the server font remains selectable.
Chinese: 字体预览不可用；仍可选择服务器字体。

English: Adjust the text or placement box, then preview the result again.
Chinese: 调整文字或位置框，然后再次预览结果。

English: Rendering an exact preview. Your page is unchanged…
Chinese: 正在渲染精确预览。您的页面未更改…

English: The draft changed while rendering. Preview it again.
Chinese: 渲染期间草稿已更改。请再次预览。

English: Review the exact result, then select Apply change to save it.
Chinese: 检查精确结果，然后选择“应用更改”保存。

English: This font cannot write some of these characters. Choose a font for this language.
Chinese: 此字体无法书写其中一些字符。请选择适用于该语言的字体。

English: We could not clear the original ink without risking other page content. Select different words. Your page is unchanged.
Chinese: 我们无法在不影响页面其他内容的情况下清除原有字迹。请选择其他文字。您的页面未更改。

English: The new letters would cover nearby text. Move or resize the transparent placement box, or use a smaller font.
Chinese: 新字母会覆盖附近的文字。请移动或调整透明位置框的大小，或使用更小的字体。

English: The replacement does not fit. Use a smaller font or widen the placement box.
Chinese: 替换内容放不下。请使用更小的字体或加宽位置框。

English: The preview could not be rendered. Your page is unchanged.
Chinese: 无法渲染预览。您的页面未更改。
正在检查文字是否合适…

English: The text does not fit the replacement box, even after automatic fitting. Use a smaller font or widen the box. Your page is unchanged.
Chinese: 即使经过自动调整，文字仍放不进替换框。请使用更小的字体或加宽文本框。您的页面未更改。

English: The selected OCR words cannot be edited safely. Select the words again. Your page is unchanged.
Chinese: 所选 OCR 文字无法安全编辑。请重新选择文字。您的页面未更改。

English: We could not apply this change. Review the box and try again.
Chinese: 无法应用此更改。请检查文本框后重试。
更改已应用。正在刷新页面…

English: The text does not fit the replacement box. Use a smaller font or widen the box. The previous page is unchanged.
Chinese: 文字放不进替换框。请使用更小的字体或加宽文本框。之前的页面未更改。

English: We could not clear the original ink without risking other page content. Try a different word selection. The previous page is unchanged.
Chinese: 我们无法在不影响页面其他内容的情况下清除原有字迹。请尝试选择其他文字。之前的页面未更改。

English: The new letters would cover nearby text. Move or resize the transparent placement box, or use a smaller font. The previous page is unchanged.
Chinese: 新字母会覆盖附近的文字。请移动或调整透明位置框的大小，或使用更小的字体。之前的页面未更改。

English: This font cannot write some of these characters. Choose a font for this language and try again. The previous page is unchanged.
Chinese: 此字体无法书写其中一些字符。请选择适用于该语言的字体后重试。之前的页面未更改。

English: This font is unavailable for rendering. Choose another font and try again. The previous page is unchanged.
Chinese: 此字体无法用于渲染。请选择其他字体后重试。之前的页面未更改。

English: Rendering failed. The previous page is unchanged.
Chinese: 渲染失败。之前的页面未更改。

English: Upload an image or draw below. Nothing is saved until you place it on the page.
Chinese: 上传图片或在下方绘制。在您将其放到页面上之前不会保存任何内容。

English: Choose PNG or JPEG · up to 5 MB
Chinese: 选择 PNG 或 JPEG · 最大 5 MB

English: If light pen strokes disappear, reduce the strength or keep the original. Best with ink on light paper.
Chinese: 如果浅色笔迹消失，请降低强度或保留原图。深色墨水写在浅色纸上效果最佳。

English: Draw with your mouse, pen or finger. The background stays transparent.
Chinese: 用鼠标、笔或手指绘制。背景保持透明。

English: Visual signature only — not a certified electronic signature.
Chinese: 仅为视觉签名 — 不是经认证的电子签名。

English: Choose a PNG or JPEG image smaller than 5 MB.
Chinese: 请选择小于 5 MB 的 PNG 或 JPEG 图片。

English: Could not prepare the drawing. Please try again.
Place a transparent mark without text recognition.
Chinese: 无需文字识别即可放置透明标记。

English: Click a checkbox on the page to place your mark. You can zoom first.
Chinese: 点击页面上的复选框以放置您的标记。您可以先缩放。

English: Make this page searchable and ready for future text editing.
Chinese: 让此页可搜索，并为将来的文字编辑做好准备。

English: Text recognition did not finish. Your scan is unchanged.
Chinese: 文字识别未完成。您的扫描件未更改。

English: Text recognition is not available right now. Please try again.
Chinese: 文字识别目前不可用。请重试。

English: We could not refresh text recognition. Please try again.
Chinese: 无法刷新文字识别。请重试。

English: Drag across recognized words to select them. Use arrow keys to move, Shift with an arrow key to extend the selection, Enter to select one word, and Escape to clear.
Chinese: 拖动选择已识别的文字。使用方向键移动，Shift 加方向键扩展选择，Enter 选择单个词，Esc 清除。

English: Handwritten text editing is not available yet.
Chinese: 暂不支持编辑手写文字。
未检测到可选择的文字

English: Replacement preview box. Arrow keys move, Shift and arrow keys resize.
Chinese: 替换预览框。方向键移动，Shift 加方向键调整大小。

English: Other text overlaps this transparent guide. Only actual new letters that cover other words will be blocked.
Chinese: 其他文字与此透明参考框重叠。只有实际覆盖其他文字的新字母才会被阻止。

English: Recommended. Flattens the page, turns paper white and ink crisp, clears desk edges and punch holes. Colourful cards keep their colours.
Chinese: 推荐。拉平页面，使纸张变白、字迹清晰，并去除桌面边缘和打孔痕迹。彩色卡片会保留原有颜色。

English: The flattened photo with its own colours and lighting. Nothing is cleaned.
Chinese: 拉平后的照片，保留其原有颜色和光线，不做任何清理。
轻度增强对比度和锐度。

English: Lightens a dark photo while keeping its colours.
Chinese: 提亮较暗的照片，同时保留其颜色。

English: Evens out uneven lighting while keeping ink colours and faint strokes.
Chinese: 均衡不均匀的光线，同时保留墨迹颜色和细淡笔画。

English: Removes colour and keeps shades of grey.
Chinese: 去除颜色，保留灰度层次。

English: Crisp black text on white. Faint handwriting may disappear.
Chinese: 白底清晰黑字。较淡的手写内容可能会消失。

English: This page uses a look that is no longer offered. Choose one of the looks above to replace it.
Chinese: 此页面使用的外观已不再提供。请从上方选择一种外观进行替换。

English: Make your scan look its best
Chinese: 让扫描件呈现最佳效果

English: {corner} corner. Use arrow keys to adjust.
Drag the four corners onto the paper edges
Chinese: 将四个角拖到纸张边缘

English: You can choose another look while this finishes.
Chinese: 处理期间你可以选择其他效果。

English: Changes saved automatically · Ready to use
Chinese: 更改已自动保存 · 可以使用

English: Place each corner on the paper edge.
Chinese: 将每个角放在纸张边缘上。

English: Keep the four corners in clockwise order.
Chinese: 请按顺时针顺序放置四个角。

English: Your original photo is kept. You can change the look anytime.
Chinese: 你的原始照片已保留。你可以随时更改效果。

English: Default for photos: flatten the page to its true proportions, turn paper white and ink crisp, and clear desk edges and punch holes. Colourful cards keep their colours.
Chinese: 照片默认：将页面还原为真实比例，使纸张变白、字迹清晰，并清除桌面边缘和打孔。彩色卡片保留原有颜色。

English: Keep the photo’s colors without enhancement.
Chinese: 保留照片原有颜色，不做增强。

English: Improve contrast and gently sharpen text.
Chinese: 提高对比度并适度锐化文字。

English: Lighten a dark photo while keeping its colors.
Chinese: 提亮较暗的照片并保留颜色。

English: Reduce uneven lighting while retaining ink colors and faint strokes. No OCR rewriting or automatic erasing of marks.
Chinese: 减轻光线不均，同时保留墨水颜色和淡笔迹。不做 OCR 改写，也不会自动擦除标记。

English: Remove color and retain shades of gray.
Chinese: 去除颜色，保留灰度层次。

English: Create crisp black text on white. Faint handwriting may disappear.
Chinese: 生成白底清晰黑字。淡的手写字迹可能会消失。

English: The crop editor is unavailable. Only accepted JPG and PNG photos can be adjusted.
Chinese: 裁剪编辑器不可用。只有已接受的 JPG 和 PNG 照片可以调整。

English: The crop could not be processed. Adjust the corners and apply again, or retry Auto detect.
Chinese: 无法处理裁剪。请调整角点后重新应用，或重试自动检测。

English: Could not read the crop status. Reload and try again.
Chinese: 无法读取裁剪状态。请重新加载后重试。

English: This crop was changed in another session. Reload before applying your changes.
Chinese: 此裁剪已在另一个会话中被更改。请先重新加载再应用你的更改。

English: Could not save this crop. Check the corners and try again.
Chinese: 无法保存此裁剪。请检查角点后重试。

English: Your scan was saved, but its preview could not load. Reload the result.
Chinese: 你的扫描件已保存，但预览无法加载。请重新加载结果。

English: Drag a small rectangle around a hole or unwanted mark. Review before applying.
Chinese: 在孔洞或不需要的痕迹周围拖出一个小矩形。应用前请先检查。

English: Could not open this page for cleanup. Reload and try again.
Chinese: 无法打开此页面进行清理。请重新加载后重试。

English: Limit reached: remove an area before adding another.
Chinese: 已达上限：请先移除一个区域再添加。

English: Choose a small area, no more than 3% of the page.
